free_tier.stated: no total size and no bandwidth limit; under 2 GiB per file; 1,000 assets per release

retention.stated: an asset lives until the release is deleted

egress.terms: no bandwidth limit stated; ranged GETs served from release-assets.githubusercontent.com with a fresh signature per request

chaining: the bulk egress lane that needs no domain and no card: the 2 GiB per-asset cap sets the shard size and the volume is not metered, so it composes with a manifest and a ranged fetcher.
reliability_note: the download URL redirects to a signed release-assets host; the signature is per request

evidence.proved: 'Up to 1000 release assets may be associated with a single release. Each file included in a release must be under 2 GiB. There is no limit on the total size of a release, nor bandwidth usage'
